claims.says: 'Approach to Sunrise Lake camp' — 'follow Foggy Dew Creek Trail #417 up through forest and past Foggy Dew Falls, then climb steadily to the Sunrise Lake basin... campsites sit on the north end of the lake (~7,100 ft)'
'Summit push and hike out' — 'follow the open ridge/parkland northeast of Sunrise Lake onto Switchback Mountain's northwest ridge, an easy Class 2 scramble to the 8,321 ft summit'
same Sunrise Lake / northwest ridge text as the itinerary
'From Cooney Lake, a boot path continues about a mile to gain the broad Southeast Ridge...'
Foggy Dew TH → Foggy Dew Falls → Merchants Basin/Cooney Lake Trail split → Cooney Lake (Campsite) → Cooney Pass → Southeast Ridge scramble → summit — no Sunrise Lake waypoint exists
'Reverse the Southeast Ridge down to Cooney Pass and Cooney Lake'
'Final summit scramble (Southeast Ridge)'
'Cooney Lake to the southeast ridge' / 'Southeast ridge to the summit'
'Foggy Dew Creek and Merchants Basin to Cooney Lake'

contradictions.fact: route identity: claimed 1936 'West Fork of Agnes Creek' line vs the actual body content describing the Asa Peak NE Ridge/South Ridge line

claims.says: 'First climbed in 1936 by W. Ronald Frazier and Dan O'Brien via the West Fork of Agnes Creek...'

'Agnes Creek trail, Spruce Creek and the brush climb to Upper Blue Basin' (not a West Fork Agnes Creek line)
describe the same 3-rappel chimney/south-col/couloir descent as the South Ridge (via Asa Peak NE Ridge) route

contradictions.why: The route's name and its overview/beta/fa all claim this is the distinct, original 1936 line up the West Fork of Agnes Creek, but its own approach, climbing_route, approach_variants, and descent_text/rappel_detail describe the Asa Peak NE Ridge → South Ridge → chimney crux line — essentially identical to the OTHER route on this peak (wa_agnes_mountain_south_ridge). A field on this route (the body) describes what reads as a different, already-catalogued route.
contradictions.internal_resolution: The detailed body fields (approach, climbing_route, approach_variants, descent_text, rappel_detail — 5 fields, internally consistent with each other and with the other Agnes route) all describe the Asa Peak/South Ridge line; only the opening of overview, beta, and fa claim a separate 'West Fork of Agnes Creek' line. Which route this page is actually meant to represent cannot be settled from the row alone.
